entries.message: Extension regrouping no longer leaves empty current folders behind, and orange groups are easier to distinguish from yellow
Signed-in extension panels use isolated sessions with tighter cookie protections for other sites and Spaces
Prevent a crash when an idle extension wakes while its side panel remains open
Text replacement follows your Mac settings and keeps your choice when Crest restarts
Keep tab-specific extension panels with their own pages and restore each panel when returning to its tab
Extension screenshots capture the selected page correctly
